common.save_screenshot: Don't forget to save your result with a screenshot!

landing.hero_desc: Discover how you interact with AI tools. Are you a prompt engineer, a code verifier, or an automation wizard?
landing.feature_16types_desc: Detailed analysis of your AI habits.

VKHG.title: The Intuitive Prototyper
VKHG.quote: Turning big ideas into reality with a friendly touch.
VKHG.desc: You thrive on vision and speed. You provide a general concept, treat the AI like a creative partner, and love seeing the results pop up instantly in your IDE. You value the "vibe" and trust the AI to fill in the blanks while you maintain a positive, collaborative environment.

VKHC.title: The Agile Visionary
VKHC.quote: Piping big dreams directly into the machine.
VKHC.desc: You combine high-level conceptual thinking with the power of the terminal. You prefer to give a broad prompt and let a CLI agent handle the execution in one go. You are polite to your tools but prefer the speed and automation of a terminal-first workflow.

VKTG.title: The Speed Alchemist
VKTG.desc: You want results, and you want them now. You use high-level "vibe" prompts but keep the interaction strictly professional and transactional. You love the visual feedback of the IDE and expect the AI to deliver a working prototype in a single shot without any "yapping."

VKTC.title: The Ghost Pilot
VKTC.quote: Commanding the terminal with a silent, conceptual hand.
VKTC.desc: You are a minimalist who values efficiency. You drop a conceptual command into the terminal and expect the AI to execute it perfectly without discussion. You don't need a GUI or small talk—just raw, automated output based on your intuitive direction.

VRHG.title: The Collaborative Designer
VRHG.quote: Building a masterpiece through a shared creative journey.
VRHG.desc: For you, coding with AI is a conversation. You start with a feeling or a style and refine it over hundreds of messages in your IDE. You treat the AI as a true teammate, valuing the polite, iterative process of making something great together.

VRHC.title: The Terminal Partner
VRHC.quote: Iterating on ideas through the power of the shell.
VRHC.desc: You love the flexibility of the terminal but enjoy a long, polite dialogue with your AI agents. You provide conceptual goals and work through them step-by-step in the CLI, treating the AI as a knowledgeable partner in your systematic exploration.

VRTG.title: The Iterative Director
VRTG.quote: Polishing the vision with disciplined precision.
VRTG.desc: You lead the project with a strong sense of style but a firm hand. You use the IDE to continuously refine the AI's output, keeping the relationship strictly professional. You don't mind a long chat as long as it results in the exact "vibe" you were looking for.

VRTC.title: The Shell Strategist
VRTC.quote: Deep-diving into concepts through the command line.
VRTC.desc: You are a power user who refines intuitive ideas through the terminal. You don't need a GUI to see progress; you prefer the raw interaction of the CLI to iterate on your vision. You are a cold taskmaster who values the iterative path to a systematic solution.

SKHG.title: The Precise Teammate
SKHG.quote: Clear instructions for a smooth, friendly workflow.
SKHG.desc: You believe in clarity and kindness. You provide detailed specs and "few-shot" examples in your IDE, and you appreciate the AI's polite responses. You aim for perfect one-shot results by being as clear as possible from the start.

SKHC.title: The Logic Commander
SKHC.quote: Structured automation with a polite touch.
SKHC.desc: You are the master of the structured terminal prompt. You provide detailed architectural rules and expect the CLI agent to follow them perfectly. You maintain a polite tone, but your focus is on the precision and logic of the one-shot execution.

SKTG.title: The Efficiency Expert
SKTG.quote: Strict specs for flawless, visual execution.
SKTG.desc: You treat your prompts like legal documents. You provide exact requirements in the IDE and expect the AI to execute them without conversation. You value the "Accept/Reject" workflow and want the highest quality code in the shortest amount of time.

SKTC.title: The Automation Master
SKTC.quote: Pure logic, pure code, pure terminal.
SKTC.desc: You are the ultimate efficiency machine. You drop detailed, structured specs into the terminal and expect a perfect file in return. No small talk, no GUI, just pure imperative commands and systematic one-shot results.

SRHG.title: The Quality Architect
SRHG.quote: Collaborating on every detail to ensure perfection.
SRHG.desc: You combine high standards with a friendly, iterative approach. You provide strict specs in the IDE but enjoy discussing the implementation details with the AI over time. You value both technical precision and a positive working relationship.

SRHC.title: The Systems Engineer
SRHC.quote: Building robust systems through structured terminal dialogue.
SRHC.desc: You are methodical and professional. You use the terminal to refine complex, spec-heavy logic through a polite, step-by-step dialogue. You treat the AI as a professional peer that helps you verify every line of your system's architecture.

SRTG.title: The Methodical Supervisor
SRTG.desc: You are the guardian of the codebase. You provide detailed requirements and use the IDE's visual tools to iterate until the logic is flawless. You keep a professional distance from the AI, focusing entirely on the disciplined refinement of the code.

SRTC.title: The Code Purist
SRTC.quote: Refining logic in the terminal with absolute discipline.
SRTC.desc: You are the most systematic developer. You provide heavy specs and use terminal agents to refine code through a strictly imperative, long-form loop. You don't want help or "vibes"—you want a tool that can handle disciplined, high-precision engineering.
